title: Rivals of the Feed - an in-progress platform fighter I'm working on!
author: yuhboimarc
selftext: Built from scratch with Claude. Animation is primarily through Wan with some Claude procedural animation used to make character movement a bit smoother. I used ChatGPT to generate my characters, stages, menu backgrounds, and more.

comments.author: yuhboimarc
comments.body: Any and all feedback is requested and super welcome 🙏

comments.author: ElectionImpossible54
comments.body: You aren't going to want to leave your the circles with move names (keybinds or controller binds?) overlaying the action but it's looking good so far.

comments.author: Extra-Yard-7458
comments.body: The characters and selection screens look ugly asf, looks too much like ai

replies.author: yuhboimarc
replies.body: Honestly fair, and I think if my dad is up for it I'll have him draw everything which should make it much more authentic visually.

comments.author: RickRelentless
comments.body: Genuine question; who is this game for? and why would they want to play this game over other options?

comments.author: NovaGuarda
comments.body: The mechanics and programming looks solid, but the visuals are just not there. The characters shrink and expand. 2D animation is something AI is terrible at. I'd suggest you pivot to 3D and use meshy/tripo for your models, make something like smash bros but bug bros

replies.author: yuhboimarc
replies.body: I didn't even realize this was an option. I appreciate this a bunch!

comments.author: yuhboimarc
comments.body:
Genuinely, this feedback is great everyone. I really, seriously appreciate it. If I don't make a single dollar off of this game I am okay with that - I really just made this game as a passion project inspired by my dad. He and I always talked about making a fighting game with insects, and he loves insects soooo much.

I think I may ask him to draw the characters for me and then plug them into Meshy AI (thank you so much for this wonderful recommendation). My dad is an artist, so it just so happens to work out 💀🐛
